name: Lagnam Spintex Limited

verdict_notes: revenue growth under 15% YoY without 30%+ profit growth

annual_report.business: Lagnam Spintex is a leading manufacturer of premium Ring Spun and Open-End Cotton Yarns, serving customers across domestic and international markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Expenditure Incurred during the year

guidance_or_targets.statement: Spinners' margins are expected to contract by 50-100 basis points in FY2026, particularly in the second half of the year.

key_risks: US Tariff Hike: The US imposed a 50% effective tariff on Indian apparel exports in August 2025, which has a trickle-down effect on the demand for Indian cotton yarn.
Reduced Export Incentives: Export rebates under the RoDTEP scheme have been cut from 3.4% to 1.7% of the FOB value, directly impacting export profitability.
Competition: Indian spinners face stiff competition from countries with lower tariff rates.
High Import Dependency: Due to low local output, reliance on imported cotton is rising (up 85% YoY in 5M FY2026), increasing costs for manufacturers.
Crop Damage & Acreage Shift: Untimely rainfall in major producing states has damaged crops. Farmers are shifting to more profitable crops, reducing the overall cultivated area.
Margin Contraction: Spinners' margins are expected to contract by 50-100 basis points in FY2026, particularly in the second half of the year.
Declining Contribution Levels: Average cotton yarn contributions dropped from Rs. 103/kg in H1 FY2026 to Rs. 96/kg in November 2025.
